title: LADA Doofers vs Jurassic Puck, Sep 13
notes: LADA Doofers' first game of the season, processed after the Sep 19 one. Away at Renton: we wore light blue and had the left bench. LADA's schedule view didn't show the game; its id (32947) was found by probing the ids next to the other teams' Sep 13 games.

The game sheet (SportNinja, read through its public API) gave the score, the scorers, the shots and who played; each goal was found on the video and against the arena scoreboard, 6 to 13 s before the time the sheet's clock implies.

Periods from the board's clock: the empty-ice proposal ran each period on through a short intermission countdown (about 1:00) that the board showed after the 1st and the 2nd, so each period ends at the board's first 00.0 and starts when the clock leaves 18:00. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd.
Wheeler #0 in goal (#1 Mayorov and #20 Starodubtsev absent). Ten skaters, the same ten as LADA's lines and the game sheet. Absent: #4, #11, #12, #13, #16, #25, #26, #27, #31, #44, #54, #61, #69, #97.
No penalties on either side. Shots from the board, matching the game sheet (19-51).
Nothing labeled by hand: the lineup check passed on the reviewers' labels alone. Reads of 86 and 18 were Tislenok's 98.
